start: Signed in, Settings, Backup and restore, card 'Keep your workouts on MettleUp'

user_sees: Question 'Delete your MettleUp account?' - 'This deletes your account and everything saved on MettleUp's server. The workouts on this phone stay.'
must_not: Anything deleted before the question is answered

user_sees: 'Your account and everything saved on MettleUp are deleted. Your workouts are still on this phone.'
The card shows 'Continue with Google' again
must_not: The saved copy left on the server

start: Signed in member whose Google account is also a gym owner's or trainer's sign-in

user_sees: 'Everything saved on MettleUp is deleted. Your Google sign-in stays, because your gym also uses it. Your workouts are still on this phone.'
must_not: The owner's or trainer's gym sign-in deleted

start: Settings, 'Erase or start over', choose 'Erase this phone and delete my MettleUp account'

steps.action: Confirm the erase with account delete
user_sees: The account is deleted first, then the phone is erased and the welcome screen opens
must_not: The phone erased while the account delete failed (an empty phone and a full account)

start: Signed in, no internet or the server refuses

steps.action: Tap 'Delete my account', then 'Delete account', offline
user_sees: 'No internet right now. Your workouts are safe on this phone. Try again when you are online.'
must_not: 'deleted' shown when the server was never reached
The phone forgetting the account while the server copy remains

steps.action: Tap 'Continue with Google' with the same Google account
user_sees: A fresh, empty account; this phone's workouts are sent up again
Not signed in; the 'deleted' line once
must_not: The 'Delete my account' button still shown

steps.action: After deletion, ask what the server still holds
user_sees: Nothing of the saved copy; backup copies expire within 7 days
must_not: Saved workouts left on the server
A gym's sign-in deleted for a shared Google account
